title: Week Ahead: From Apple to Arconic, the Fed to Jobs Friday, We've Got You Covered - TheStreet
text:
We have another busy week down here on Wall Street!
Earnings are coming from the likes of Apple ( AAPL ) , Tesla ( TSLA ) , Wayfair ( W ) and CBS ( CBS ) .
Apple is a holding in Jim Cramer's Action Alerts PLUS Portfolio . The Federal Open Market Committee meetings start Tuesday so expect a statement at 2p Wednesday. And you by now it's all about the language.
Not to mention it's Jobs Friday! The first Friday of every month, the U.S. Department of Labor's Bureau of Labor Statistics releases the Employment Situation Summary, otherwise known as the Employment or Jobs Report.
And as Scott Gamm noted in the video above, if the number's good, expect a tweet from our President!
So watch the video above as we highlight all the important things you need to look out for this week!
